- The two V6 long files are byte-identical. Treat one as the text and the other as an alias.
- The V5 delivery packages share a 29,029-byte, 220-line common body with SHA-256 0da3d3c2a206e6821bb2dc5ba9ca18b2dcb951ba5ffcc7a9446ef662054f4dee. Their target-specific wrappers still matter.
- The v3 provenance name “Persona.md” refers to the 32,038-byte V1 input matching Persona(1).md, not the distinct 76,958-byte PERSONA.md revision 0.8. Avoid conflating case/title aliases.
- The 248-row historical coverage audit's categories were checked: 147 live-untested, 27 synthetic, 65 static, seven reported storage verifications, two unsupported. Its reported storage categories do not supply all original store-object receipts.
- V6 document checks match recovered source bytes/hash/structure. They explicitly do not certify runtime/acoustics and report an unavailable memory save.
- Retrieved prior conversation context records scoped acceptance and limited delivery. It does not prove present account settings, fresh-session loading, or phone voice. No conversation URL was available for every retrieved record; none is invented here.
- S13 distinguishes earlier parent-reported saved/readback preferences from revision 1.1 prepared but not confirmed saved. The original parent readback transcript is not reproduced; preserve the dated report without upgrading it to current direct proof.
- S14 embeds historical application/test identifiers, a synthetic probe/hash result and verification JSON. It reports one dispatch/return/integration cycle without a manual courier, using gpt-6.1-sol at medium effort. A later checkpoint screenshot is described and hashed, but the image itself is not embedded. This is richer historical evidence than a bare wrapper, not independent current testing, High-effort validation or fresh-session/audio proof.
